plotTitle: A Pottsfield Burial: The Harvest of Bound Spirits
mainObjective: Unravel the necromantic curse binding Pottsfield and its lands, uncovering the truth behind ancient pacts, malevolent rituals, and restless dead before the entire region is lost to darkness.

plotPoints.title: Shadows Over Pottsfield: Arrival at the Outskirts
plotPoints.description: The party arrives at the edge of Pottsfield (PO001), greeted by golden fields and the anxious preparations for the Harvest Festival. Despite the cheerful facade, rumors of missing villagers and restless spirits abound. Deputy Silas Cragg requests their help investigating disappearances, while suggestions point toward the town center and the old parish grounds.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Establishes the module’s tone, introduces key NPCs, and sets up initial mysteries that lead deeper into Pottsfield.

sideQuests.title: Pumpkin Patch Prowlers
sideQuests.description: Ezra Pike asks the party to investigate his trampled pumpkin patch, believing mischievous spirits or vandals are at work. Clues may lead toward the Parish Grounds.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals tracks leading to the Parish Grounds and hints about nocturnal activity.

sideQuests.title: The Lantern Maker's Secret
sideQuests.description: Ezra Pike, the village lantern maker, offers to share what he knows if the party retrieves a stolen shipment of rare oils from a bandit hideout at the edge of the Outskirts, providing hints about the masked revelers.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Gaining Ezra’s trust opens new avenues in the investigation and may earn the party specialized lanterns that reveal hidden spirits.

sideQuests.title: Old Nan’s Omen
sideQuests.description: Old Nan Berryman cryptically warns of 'soil disturbed and bargains kept.' If the party helps her gather herbs from the Shrouded Woods’ edge, she offers a divination using bones.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides an omen about a burial site, foreshadowing secrets in the crypts.

sideQuests.title: Martha’s Lost Locket
sideQuests.description: Martha Finch requests the party’s help finding her lost locket, last seen near the edge of the Shrouded Woods.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Finding the locket grants Martha’s trust and a clue about spectral sightings in the woods.

plotPoints.title: Masks and Misdirection: The Hearthlands’ Revels
plotPoints.description: Following leads from the outskirts, the party heads into Pottsfield Hearthlands (PVC001), where a masked harvest masquerade is stirring unease amid forced cheer. The enigmatic Masked Reveler and Widow Elsie Tallow hold secrets about the town’s pacts and the Parish Grounds. Social intrigue and careful questioning are vital, as villagers’ attitudes depend on the party’s tact.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Deepens the mystery, introduces the masked cult, and directs the party toward the Parishlands and the roots of the hauntings.

sideQuests.title: A Widow’s Grief
sideQuests.description: Widow Elsie Tallow hints her late husband’s death was not natural. Investigating his grave in secret could reveal tampered earth and spectral activity.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides clues about spiritual unrest and the unholy rituals tying spirits to Pottsfield.

sideQuests.title: The Reveler's Wager
sideQuests.description: The Masked Reveler challenges the party to supernatural festival games. Winning earns the respect of the townsfolk and a magical token; losing may invoke a minor curse or public suspicion.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Affects the party’s reputation and how open villagers are with information.

plotPoints.title: The Unquiet Parish: Investigating the Parishlands
plotPoints.description: The party moves to Pottsfield Parishlands (PPG001), where desperate townsfolk report ghostly apparitions, unearthed graves, and chilling voices at night. Bound spirits hint at an ancient pact sealed in the crypts beneath the Harvest Grounds. The party must navigate between the living and the dead, uncovering the truth behind Pottsfield’s bargains and the origins of the curse.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals the nature of Pottsfield’s curse—a series of desperate bargains for prosperity. The party gains knowledge needed to break or perpetuate the pact.

sideQuests.title: Restless Ancestors
sideQuests.description: Old Nan Berryman begs the party to recover a stolen heirloom from The Shrouded Necropolis to soothe her family’s spirit.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Returning the heirloom allows the party to commune with a Freed Spirit for crucial information.

sideQuests.title: Songs for the Departed
sideQuests.description: A masked reveler insists that music might calm the spirits; the party may lead a midnight vigil to gain spiritual allies or antagonize ghosts.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Success grants a charm against possession; failure may cause a haunting later.

sideQuests.title: Appease the Bound Spirit
sideQuests.description: A Bound Spirit, trapped by unfinished business, offers information if the party finds and returns a lost token buried nearby.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals a hidden entrance to the crypts and insights into the ritual.

sideQuests.title: The Vigil's Plea
sideQuests.description: Desperate Townsfolk beg for help defending their vigil from nightly attacks by the restless dead.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Protecting the vigil earns the party an ally and a blessing against undead.

plotPoints.title: Through the Shrouded Woods to Veilwood Expanse
plotPoints.description: Spectral clues and omens direct the party to the Shrouded Woods (TSW001), a haunted wilderness separating Pottsfield from the deeper crypts. Here, they encounter the Specter of Jonny Harrow and Father Milgrom, both offering cryptic warnings or bargains. The woods’ mists hint at a greater power—Gloamroot—whose corruption may be fueling Pottsfield’s curse. The party discovers a hidden entrance to the Ancient Crypts and may choose to explore the Veilwood’s heart.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Connects the hauntings to a wider supernatural force, introduces the possibility of breaking the curse at its root, and bridges wilderness and cryptic threats.

sideQuests.title: The Harrow Bargain
sideQuests.description: The Specter of Jonny Harrow offers secret information if the party agrees to deliver a message to Deputy Silas Cragg.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides leverage with local law or a shortcut into the crypts.

sideQuests.title: Relics of the Forgotten
sideQuests.description: Father Milgrom asks the party to recover sacred relics from the crypts, which could protect the village or empower the ritual.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Relics can tip the final confrontation toward the townsfolk or the antagonist.

sideQuests.title: Lay Jonny Harrow to Rest
sideQuests.description: Jonny Harrow's spirit cannot move on until his murderer is exposed in Pottsfield. The party can seek justice, gaining his aid.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Secures ghostly assistance or a powerful artifact for the final encounter.

plotPoints.title: Secrets Beneath: The Shrouded Necropolis
plotPoints.description: The party descends into the vine-choked tombs of the Shrouded Necropolis (TAC001), beneath the Harvest Grounds. Here, ancient graves have been disturbed and forbidden rituals echo in the gloom. The party must navigate shifting shadows, deathly traps, and confront the Bound Spirit’s growing influence. The choices made thus far—regarding spirits, relics, and townsfolk—determine the necropolis’ dangers and the outcome of the final ritual.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party must choose whether to break the pacts that bind Pottsfield, renew them, or attempt a new path—each with great risk and cost.

sideQuests.title: A Grieving Widow’s Plea
sideQuests.description: Widow Elsie Tallow begs the party to retrieve a locket buried with her late husband in a mausoleum near the necropolis entrance.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Completing this quest can grant the party a charm that protects against undead.

sideQuests.title: The Missing Gravedigger
sideQuests.description: Ezra Pike, the local gravedigger, has gone missing after hearing whispers from the old crypts. Finding him could provide clues about the necropolis and its dangers.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Rescuing Ezra offers insights into the necropolis layout and hazards.

sideQuests.title: The Whispering Statues
sideQuests.description: Shattered statues in the crypts whisper secrets about the necropolis’ past. If reassembled or their riddles solved, they reveal hidden passages or ritual components.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Uncovers shortcuts or weaknesses of the Bound Spirit.

sideQuests.title: The Lost Key
sideQuests.description: A hidden compartment in the altar holds a bone key, granting access to a sealed tomb rumored to house an artifact that can strengthen or disrupt the binding ritual.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides additional options for the module’s climax.

sideQuests.title: The Spirits’ Bargain
sideQuests.description: Freed spirits offer cryptic assistance if the party rights a wrong or recovers a lost item from a rival spirit’s crypt.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Can weaken the Bound Spirit or pacify minor undead.

plotPoints.title: The Reaping Fields: Curse’s Heart
plotPoints.description: To ensure the curse is truly broken, the party must journey to the infamous Reaping Fields (THG001), where vanishing travelers, crimson skies, and the Shadow Harvester threaten Pottsfield’s future. Here, the party must use all they’ve learned to uncover the origin of the curse, disrupt the final ritual, and face the Shadow Harvester in a climactic confrontation. The fate of Pottsfield and its restless dead hangs in the balance.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The final battle and choices here determine whether Pottsfield’s cycle of bargains and hauntings is ended, renewed, or twisted into something worse.

sideQuests.title: A Farmer's Last Plea
sideQuests.description: A spectral figure begs the party to retrieve a family heirloom lost in the overgrown remnants of their farmstead, promising insight into the fields' curse in return.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a protective charm and crucial lore about the curse.

sideQuests.title: The Sorrowful Scarecrow
sideQuests.description: A scarecrow animated by grief searches for the soul of its lost creator. Helping it find peace could yield a powerful ally or key information.
sideQuests.plotImpact: If aided, the scarecrow spirit assists in the final battle; if ignored, it becomes a dangerous adversary later.

sideQuests.title: Harvest of the Lost
sideQuests.description: Desperate townsfolk beg the party to rescue loved ones dragged deeper into the haunted fields by unseen hands.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Rescued survivors provide information about weaknesses in the fields’ defenses or a route to the ritual site.

sideQuests.title: Circle of Remembrance
sideQuests.description: Restoring a broken circle of stones with tokens from the dead may allow spirits to intervene against the Shadow Harvester.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Can turn restless spirits into allies or provide narrative advantages in the final battle.

sideQuests.title: Bound for Release
sideQuests.description: A group of bound spirits pleads for release. The party can attempt a risky ritual to lay them to rest—or bind them for future aid, at a moral cost.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Granting peace earns boons; binding them grants power, but risks new hauntings.

sideQuests.title: The Last Harvest
sideQuests.description: Desperate Townsfolk beg the party to save their loved ones among the Bound Spirits—forcing a difficult choice about who can be saved.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Personalizes the outcome for villagers, with social and moral consequences after the adventure.

sideQuests.title: Seeds of Renewal
sideQuests.description: If the party recovers a lost relic from the crypt’s heart, they can attempt a new ritual—one that offers hope of breaking the cycle without destroying the town’s prosperity.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks a potential 'best ending' that frees spirits and preserves the harvest, but requires difficult checks and negotiation.

plotPoints.title: Breaking the Veil: Consequences and Dawn
plotPoints.description: With the ritual disrupted and the curse’s heart confronted, the mists begin to recede across Pottsfield, the Parishlands, and the haunted fields. Freed spirits guide the party back through the Veilwood Expanse. The survivors cautiously emerge, and the fate of Pottsfield—salvation, spectral havoc, or a new cycle—rests on the party’s choices. The adventure closes with the region forever changed and the party’s legacy echoing in Pottsfield’s fields.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Wraps up the consequences of the party’s choices and sets the stage for future adventures or regional changes.

sideQuests.title: Return What Was Taken
sideQuests.description: A grateful spirit requests help returning a stolen relic to a sunken altar along the Veilwood. Doing so will lay the last of the restless dead to peace.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Ensures lingering magical effects are dispelled—failure may leave Pottsfield haunted.
